runtime.brokerScope: Previously installed broker, not a build or acceptance verdict for current Runner main; lacks the new private owner-shutdown control.
runtime.artifactVerificationScope: The installed broker's fixed pinned-artifact/native-sandbox launch path; separate final hashing verified the installed runtime files. No new independent model-payload hash was performed.

workload.scope: One owner-authorized bounded local workload. Model work stopped after the intermediate PTQ1 cleanup observation; final cleanup and retention used the same original allowance.

metric.interval: HTTP connection/request through complete framed SSE response read; includes prefill, generation, transport and client framing; excludes startup and final event interpretation.
metric.ttftAndGenerationScope: The client buffered each whole response. First/last generated-token arrival timestamps were not captured; neither TTFT nor generation tokens/s can be reconstructed. Request tokens/s includes TTFT.
metric.futureSeparatedMetrics: Record request-start-to-first-token TTFT separately from subsequent-token generation throughput. Per-token timing or runtime decode counters must establish the generation interval; SSE event/byte counts alone cannot do so.

unmeasured.reason: Not started after the cleanup fault; no retry or continuation workload.

aggregatePower.scope: Endpoint observations plus one-second per-arm samples; samples do not prove uninterrupted stability or establish past power for historical runs.

finalCleanup.scope: Later final observation of known model names and removed owned credential files, not independent Job accounting or a successful graceful-shutdown verdict.

retainedReceipts.scope: Started after the model loop had already stopped; no interventions occurred.
